title: How the Money Goes Back on a Northbeam Returns and Restocking Schedule
content:
Five figures decide the way a refund leaves Northbeam Electronics on a Northbeam Returns and Restocking return, and how long it takes to get there.

**The ways the refund may be paid** are the refund methods allowed on the schedule. **Return to the original method required** means whether the refund must go back the way the item was paid for. **Store credit fallback** means whether store credit is used when the original method can no longer be credited. **Settlement days** are the business days from settlement within which the money leaves the retailer. **Invoice credit days** are the days a business invoice credit takes to appear on the account.

| Return schedule | Ways the refund may be paid | Back the way it was paid | Store credit fallback | Settlement days | Invoice credit days |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Fifteen Day Return | the original card or store credit | required | available | 5 | 0 |
| Member Extended Thirty Day Return | the original card or store credit | not required | available | 3 | 0 |
| Major Appliance Forty Eight Hour Return | the original card only | required | not available | 7 | 0 |
| Activated Wireless Device Return | the original card or store credit | required | available | 5 | 0 |
| Open Box and Clearance Final Sale | store credit only | not required | available | 1 | 0 |
| Business Contract Return Schedule | business invoice credit or bank transfer | required | not available | 14 | 30 |

## Questions the schedule answers

**Which schedules pay out fastest and slowest?** Open Box and Clearance Final Sale at 1 business day and Business Contract Return Schedule at 14 business days stand at the two ends of the schedule.

**Which schedules publish an invoice credit figure?** Only Business Contract Return Schedule, at 30 days; the other five publish 0 days because no invoice credit arises on them.

**Which schedules offer no store credit fallback?** Major Appliance Forty Eight Hour Return and Business Contract Return Schedule, which are also the two schedules whose allowed methods do not include store credit at all.

**Do the settlement days and the invoice credit days count the same way?** No. The settlement days are counted in business days from settlement; the invoice credit days are the days a business invoice credit takes to appear on the account.
